mark_decomposition.answer_to_the_jv_vs_loanbook_question: The above-cost mark a year ago was NOT primarily the PSLF/PTSF II joint ventures - it was TWO concentrated controlled-affiliate EQUITY stakes. At 9/30/2025 the controlled-affiliated common equity bucket carried $170,641 of FV on $87,248 of cost, of which JF Intermediate, LLC was $68,332 FV on $4,488 cost (15.2x) and AKW Holdings Limited was $34,796 FV on $402 cost. The PSLF equity stake was actually marked BELOW cost at that date ($67,513 FV on $82,358 cost = 82.0%). So the JV equity was a DRAG on the above-cost mark, not its source; the source was two non-JV controlled equity positions. The JV equity IS now the biggest single ongoing markdown, but it never supplied the premium.

positions.name: AKW Holdings Limited - Class A through Class E

Both marks are Level 3 and both are produced by the same adviser for the same controlled borrower. Flagging the divergence as an observation - no verdict.

incentive_fee.structure: Two parts. Part one: quarterly, on Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income, against a hurdle of 1.75% per quarter (7.00% annualized) of net assets, with a 100% catch-up between the hurdle and 2.1212% per quarter (8.4848% annualized), then 17.5% of the excess. Part two: annually, 17.5% of cumulative realized capital gains net of realized losses and unrealized depreciation, less fees previously paid.
incentive_fee.PIK_COUNTS_TOWARD_THE_FEE: YES, EXPLICITLY.
